component.name: Notes
component.summary: Jot down thoughts, checklists, tables and sketches

description.p: A fast, private notes app with a clean three-pane layout: folders, a note list and the editor.

ul.li: Titles, headings, lists, checklists, tables, block quotes and colours
Folders and subfolders, pinned notes, hashtags and search
Password-locked notes, Recently Deleted, list and gallery views
Light and dark appearance, export to PDF, HTML, Markdown and text
